name: Asherati
sourceDistinctions: The player profile uses +1 natural armor and no ability adjustments. The separate p. 139 Warrior prints different armor, flash DC, and Sandswim details.
Ordinary Body Lamp glow and the once-daily free-action flash are distinct. The player flash applies to all creatures in range and lasts one minute on a failed Fortitude save.
The player entry specifies slower movement in heavier armor or with a medium load and no movement under sand with a heavy load.
Wizards’ collected archive has no Sandstorm errata file. The official FAQ has no Asherati entry.
portraitForm: Rashen Dustline, an original Asherati Rogue
